messages:
yuki: Quick heads-up — onboarding OrpheusX-lite (int4) is showing two distinct failures: a head-stride interleave (KV-cache drift after ~12 tokens) and weird punctuation vocab shadowing causing low summarization quality on conv-eval. Dropping triage notes here.
alex: rough numbers? and conversion command?
yuki: fp16 baseline ROUGE-L 42.3 on our summarize test, int8 ~41.9. int4 before fixes ROUGE-L 28.6, ppl jumped to 3.6. KV drift visible in attention offsets after head ~12. Conversion run: 
```
python3 tools/convert_model.py \
  --src orpheusx \
  --dst gemma-compatible \
  --quant int4 \
  --vocab-map maps/orpheusx_to_gemma_punct_v1.json \
  --out /builds/orpheusx_gemma_int4
```
Small tokenmap excerpt (weird zone):
```
{"46":"46","47":"47","48":"800","49":"49","50":"48"}
# note: punctuation range 46-50, id 48 mapped->800 (unexpected large id)
```
priya: That mapping (48->800) smells like an exporter that appended a punctuation cluster at the end of the vocab then referenced old indices. Could cause embedding collisions / shadowing. Also head-stride interleave issue might be independent (exporter wrote heads in stride layout).
zhen: Can you dump first 16 rotary heads (fp32) and a small attention position map for a fixed seed? I want to see if head-order is even/odd interleave or a more complex stride.
yuki: Dumped matrices and ran a quick correlation script. Permutation looks like even-then-odd (0,2,4,...,1,3,5,...). Here's the perm we inferred: 
```
H = 32
perm = list(range(0,H,2)) + list(range(1,H,2))
# observed perm = [0,2,4,...,30,1,3,5,...,31]
```
Also ran attention-position correlation (seed: "Summarize the following conversation" 16 tokens): pre-fix int4 corr dropped 42% vs fp16 after 8 tokens; after applying head reorder before quant, corr drop reduced to 6%.
alex: Good. What about the punctuation mapping fix?
priya: We patched maps/orpheusx_to_gemma_punct_v1.json locally to normalize the punctuation cluster (reassign 48->48 instead of ->800 and remap trailing cluster back into contiguous range). After re-run (head reorder + vocab patch) int4 ROUGE-L -> 42.0, ppl -> 1.95 (close to fp16 ppl 1.88). So two orthogonal issues: head-stride and vocab shadowing.
yuki: Steps I ran: 1) auto-detect head-stride by computing head-wise cosine between rotary head 0..7 and 8..15; if pattern matches even-odd block, apply perm. 2) run tokenmap sanity check: assert all mapped ids < src_vocab_size and that punctuation cluster doesn't map outside expected block.
ops-bot: ticket INF-3042 created: "OrpheusX-lite: head-stride interleave + punctuation vocab shadowing" assigned to yuki, priority P2.
zhen: Can we add a conversion flag --fix-headstride and --validate-vocab-shadowing? Also add a small unit test in conversion CI that:
- runs convert on a tiny subset
- runs seed prompt and computes attention-position correlation; fail if corr drop > 8% vs reference fp16
priya: We'll add a model-catalog metadata slice: 
```
"head_stride": "even-interleave|contiguous|unknown",
"vocab_shadowing": "none|punctuation|numeric|other"
```
So onboarding shows expected quirks.
yuki: I'll open a PR with: fix flags, the detection heuristics, a tiny triage script tools/check_vocab_shadow.py, and CI unit test (seed prompt: "Summarize the following conversation" 16 tokens). Will attach before/after dumps and a small README note for onboarding.
alex: Nice. Also add a smoke check that compares first-8 rotary heads before/after conversion and emits a tiny PNG heatmap to the artifact store.
yuki: On it. Will ping when PR ready. Thanks :thumbsup:
alex: one more ask: log the original exporter version in the model metadata (exporter_git_sha) so we can traceback if a particular exporter produced stride layout.
yuki: added to TODO in the PR. Will include exporter_git_sha and conversion flags in model catalog entry.
ops-bot: linked INF-3042 to sprint board and added severity P2.
